pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Hoe$() and $(l)Red Matter Hoe$() till soil. Craft the Dark Matter Hoe from Dark Matter and a diamond, then upgrade it into the Red Matter Hoe.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Right-click soil to till an area at once; the radius grows with charge.$(li)Like every matter tool, it never loses durability and tilling costs no EMC.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() server.items.disableAllRadiusMining.
